# chargebee_feature (Resource)

A Chargebee entitlement feature. Created features are activated automatically so items can be granted them via chargebee_item_entitlement. If a feature with the given id already exists in Chargebee, it is adopted into state and its mutable fields are updated to match this configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "chargebee_feature" "sso" {
  id   = "sso"
  name = "Single sign-on"
}

resource "chargebee_feature" "api_rate_limit" {
  id   = "api-rate-limit"
  name = "API rate limit"
  type = "quantity"
  unit = "requests/min"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the feature. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Display name of the feature.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the feature.
- `type` (String) Feature type: `switch` (the default), `custom`, `quantity`, or `range`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `unit` (String) Unit label for quantity or range features.

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) Status of the feature in Chargebee (e.g. `active`).
